question: Can cheap raw-stream and chain-structure features rank executable lossless integer compression chains well enough to reduce task-level selection regret on unseen stream families?
scope: compression utility ranking only; no novelty, general usefulness, or research-agent claim
unit: one fresh raw signed-int64 stream per task; one row per task x candidate chain
family_assignment: deterministic balanced assignment within each split; family labels are generator metadata only and are never supplied to the model
stream_group_policy: Each task has a unique stream_group formed from the generator family and hidden parameter-regime bucket. A group and all near-duplicate parameter settings belong to exactly one split; assert no group or seed overlap across train/validation/heldout.
heldout_guard: Do not generate/read heldout streams or labels, and do not use exposed integer-composition final/results files, until parent explicitly authorizes final evaluation.

task_generation.parameters: Each family has at least four hidden parameter regimes; parameters are derived from task seed and are not features. Keep one complete stream in one split.

train.walk: bounded random walk with drift/jump variants

validation.clipped_noise: clipped gaussian-like noise with varying center and scale
validation.modular_ramp: modular ramps with varying periods and offsets

heldout.piecewise_jump: piecewise smooth segments with abrupt jumps
heldout.bitwidth_extremes: near-zero, narrow low-bit, and signed high-bit extremes

task_generation.no_reuse: Do not reuse known-chain validation/final rows, exposed results, or any stream/chunk already used by integer-composition study.

features.normalization: Magnitude statistics use signedlog1p; proportions andentropy untransformed. Rawfeature x operatorcount interactions support task-conditioned linear ranking. StandardScaler fits train only forlinear models. No outcome feature.

label.raw_baseline: fixed raw signed-64 little-endian encoding with the common 9-byte header
label.bytes_total: exact output length including common header and all method-specific framing
label.eligibility: candidate contributes a target only if decode(encode(stream)) exactly equals stream; invalid/non-lossless candidates are masked, never assigned a favorable numeric gain

selection: Fit on train only; select model/hyperparameters on validation only; freeze once before heldout. Select the highest predicted eligible gain per task, with raw fallback when no predicted gain is positive.
baselines: fixed best-train chain by mean valid gain

metrics.primary: mean heldout selection regret = gain(oracle) - gain(selected), lower is better

success_rule: On heldout, model regret is lower than fixed-best-train and random, and relative gain direction is stable in each heldout family; otherwise report negative/inconclusive. No claim of novelty follows.

reproducibility.single_command: to be supplied by parent implementation

known_exclusions: No final/heldout generation before explicit parent approval
No reading or reuse of prior exposed final/results data
No diversity beta or other unavailable invalidity adjustment
No hyperparameter tuning on heldout rows
